01.reason: The woman and her seven sons runs complete from the first son's martyrdom to the Divine Voice; what follows is exegesis of the verse.

02.reason: The captive son and daughter of Rabbi Yishmael is complete from their sale to their deaths and Jeremiah's lament.

03.reason: Tzafenat bat Peniel is complete through her plea to God; the following verse is an exegetical coda, not part of the events.

04.reason: The carpenter's apprentice story runs from its setup to the sealing of the sentence; the mishna discussion of Sicarii follows.

05.reason: The Roman noblemen and the two captive children is complete; the next segments are separate site stories.

06.reason: The Beitar schoolchildren account is complete in its two segments; neighbours are other site stories.

07.reason: Rabbi Yehoshua ransoming the child in Rome is complete through identifying him as Rabbi Yishmael ben Elisha.

08.reason: Giddel bar Re'ilai's case runs through Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua's verdict, which is the outcome; the mishna discussion follows.

09.reason: Bar Haddaya's question ends with Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Asi's answer to him, the outcome of the case.

10.reason: Rabba bar bar Hana's case ends with Rabbi Elazar's answer; segment 6 is Rav Ashi's general halakhic extension, not part of the events.

11.reason: Rav Shimi bar Ashi and Abaye's fields is complete through Abaye refusing the produce; the Bei Harmakh case after it is a separate site story.

12.reason: The Bei Harmakh channel case is complete in one segment ending with Abaye's instruction.

13.reason: Rav Kahana and the dates in Huzal is complete, ending with his praise of Rabbi Yoshiya's city.

14.reason: Rav Huna and Rav Hisda's encounter with Geneiva runs from his greeting to his refusal to eat; the next mishna begins after.

15.reason: The kneading woman's case runs through the question sent to Rabbi Ami and Rabbi Hiyya bar Abba; segment 9 is the Gemara's own conclusion and stays out.

16.reason: The Nefata/Tefata case ends with Rav's ruling on it; the objections of Rabba and Rav Nahman that follow are discussion.

17.reason: Geneiva's deathbed bequest and Rabbi Zeira's ruling that Rabbi Avina may collect make the story; segment 7 on is the Gemara's analysis.

18.reason: The schoolteacher and his son case ends with Rava's ruling on it, its outcome; the next mishna follows.

19.reason: Rabbi Shimon's question to his father and Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi's answer form the complete exchange; the baraita of Isi ben Yehuda is supporting material.

20.reason: Rav Amram the pious is complete from his mistreatment to Yalta's bathhouse remedy; the Rav Yosef/Rav Sheshet remark is a different anecdote.
